note_tweet.text:
My parents paid $16,000 for the house I grew up in. It’s now worth $783,000 on Zillow.

Sounds like they made a fortune, right?

In gold terms, that house cost 450 ounces in 1962. At today’s gold price, it’s worth 250 ounces.

The house actually lost value.

Politicians get away with robbing working class people blind because most people don’t realize their nominal gains aren’t real gains.

They think they’re inflation-adjusted rich, but they’re not.

I need to learn more about this new Chinese state-owned enterprise: China National Data Group.

"China National Data Group Co., Ltd. has been established in Xiong’an New Area, Hebei Province. According to the group, it is a centrally administered state-owned enterprise whose core business is the development and utilization of data resources. Its headquarters are located in Xiong’an New Area.

The group was established to promote the development and utilization of data resources, unlock the value of data as a factor of production, support AI development, and foster a thriving data industry ecosystem.

Following its establishment, China National Data Group will work under the guidance of relevant government departments to strengthen coordination between central and local governments, deepen industrial collaboration, promote the sharing of capabilities and experience, and jointly expand business opportunities. These efforts aim to increase the economic value of data, strengthen the data industry, and improve the broader data ecosystem."
